subject.title: Add github-copilot as media-understanding image provider

question: Should the bundled GitHub Copilot provider be automatically eligible for image media-understanding, or should Copilot remain available only through direct model/image-tool paths unless the user explicitly configures an image provider?
rationale: Current source can support configured image-capable providers generically, but ordinary Copilot setup does not declare media-understanding ownership and adding it would change automatic provider routing for auth-backed automated media workflows.

options.title: Add Copilot media provider
options.body: Register GitHub Copilot as a plugin-owned image media-understanding provider with a default image model, auth-aware tests, docs, and live-proof expectations.

options.title: Keep explicit config only
options.body: Leave Copilot out of automatic media-understanding fallback and document that users must set an explicit image model/provider configuration for automated media workflows.

options.title: Defer for live proof
options.body: Keep this open until a maintainer or contributor provides live Copilot image-understanding proof and confirms model/rate-limit behavior.

recommendation.title: Add Copilot media provider
recommendation.body: Register GitHub Copilot as a plugin-owned image media-understanding provider with a default image model, auth-aware tests, docs, and live-proof expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows broad Copilot and media-provider maintenance across the affected surfaces.
